info.title: Smart EDMS API
info.description: Smart EDMS API — Enterprise-Grade SaaS Document Governance Platform with Security Audit, E-Signature, BPMN Designer, and DoD 5015.02 Records Management.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Bearer token for API keys (se_...) or service accounts (sa_...)

tags.name: Admin - Integrations
tags.description: API keys, webhooks, SSO, service accounts

get.description: Returns service health status. No authentication required — safe for load balancer probes.

post.description: Authenticate with email + password (+ optional MFA). Returns JWT session cookie.
Multipart upload. Files are validated by magic bytes, malware-scanned, checksummed (SHA-256), and encrypted with a per-document DEK (envelope encryption).

patch.description: Classification changes are audited. Downgrades require elevated permission and are blocked under legal hold.

delete.description: Respects legal hold and record status.

get.description: Returns a short-lived (60s) HMAC-signed URL. The storage resolver decrypts the file with the document's DEK before streaming.

post.description: Creates a NEW version with the content of the specified old version. Does NOT mutate the original — restores are forward-only.
Creates a new DERIVATIVE version with black rectangles over specified regions. Original is preserved immutably. Supports PDF (pdf-lib) and images (sharp).
Creates a time-limited, optionally password-protected share link. Blocked for Restricted/HS classifications.
Advisory only — never auto-applies. Heuristic + LLM fallback. Respects tenant AI feature flag.

get.description: Permission-aware search. End users see only owned documents. Includes full-text matches from DocumentTextIndex (OCR + extracted text).
Walks the per-tenant SHA-256 hash chain and reports any broken links.

post.description: Raw key shown ONCE. Only hash stored.
Signing secret shown ONCE. HMAC-SHA256 payload signing.
Grants 30-min elevated permissions with mandatory justification. Notifies all other admins. All actions audit-logged with break-glass attribution.
If approved + action=delete: soft-deletes document and generates certificate of destruction (SHA-256 hash).
Use ?action=setup|enable|disable. Setup returns QR code. Enable returns backup codes (shown once).
Verifies a second factor (TOTP or password) and issues a 5-min step-up token for privileged actions.

get.description: No auth required — the token IS the credential. Returns document metadata for the share screen.

post.description: Verifies password (if set), returns signed URL + watermark text. Increments view count.

get.description: Processes overdue approvals + sends reminders. Protected by CRON_SECRET query param. Configure external scheduler to hit hourly.

post.description: Runs: npm-audit (dependency vulns), secret detection, config validation.
DocuSign, Adobe Sign, or internal provider (auto-detected).
Records electronic signature with SHA-256 attestation hash.

post.description: Maps userTask elements to WorkflowDefinition approval steps.
